items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1976-02-13
items.q: I believe it was a a very obscure record that they made by Joe Voyages bungalow dreams yeah they made Bix and Trombau

ctx.x: You see, you never find it in a piece like this, for instance.

No, and something I might point, I might bring out here, John, is you asked me in which way did he influence music a lot. I think, as I would think right now, his use of his intonation, like his blues, his flats, flattening a note, and using it to a blues note. You see, for instance, like a... He got the most out of a blue note like that, taking and flatting it, and really, really making it something that he gave it so much feeling. You know, I mean, it's hard to explain it, but the pleasure to just hear it.…
